lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: constant rate of change versus constant ratio
lessonRef.title: Skill consolidation: constant rate of change versus constant ratio

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A linear model passes through (2, 11) and (7, 26). Write it in the form f(x) = mx + b.
A table of successive outputs reads 5, 15, 45, 135. Is the relationship linear or exponential, and why?
choices: Linear; successive outputs differ by a constant 3.
Exponential; successive outputs have a constant ratio of 3.
Quadratic; the second differences are constant.
Neither; the pattern does not repeat.

items.prompt: A population of 200 grows by 7% per year. Write the model P(t) and find the population after 4 years, to the nearest whole number.
Quantity A grows by 111 units each year. Quantity B doubles or triples each year, with ratio 2, starting from a much smaller value. Which statement is true in the long run?
choices: B exceeds A only if B starts larger than A.
B eventually exceeds A and stays ahead, however large A’s constant increase is.
The two grow at the same eventual rate.
A stays ahead permanently because 111 is larger than 2.

items.prompt: An asset's value is modelled by V(t) = 4000(0.95)^t, with t in years. What does 4000 represent?
choices: the total value lost over the asset's life
the number of years until the asset is worthless
the fraction of value retained each year, 0.95, meaning a 5% annual loss
the value of the asset when it was new, $4000

items.prompt: A linear model passes through (6, -35) and (9, -50). Write it in the form f(x) = mx + b.
A table of successive outputs reads 3, 8, 13, 18. Is the relationship linear or exponential, and why?
choices: Neither; the pattern does not repeat.
Quadratic; the second differences are constant.
Exponential; successive outputs have a constant ratio of 5.
Linear; successive outputs differ by a constant 5.

items.prompt: A population of 1900 grows by 12% per year. Write the model P(t) and find the population after 8 years, to the nearest whole number.
Quantity A grows by 48 units each year. Quantity B doubles or triples each year, with ratio 2, starting from a much smaller value. Which statement is true in the long run?
choices: B eventually exceeds A and stays ahead, however large A’s constant increase is.
The two grow at the same eventual rate.
B exceeds A only if B starts larger than A.
A stays ahead permanently because 48 is larger than 2.

choices: the number of years until the asset is worthless
the value of the asset when it was new, $300
the total value lost over the asset's life

items.prompt: A linear model passes through (3, -1) and (8, 19). Write it in the form f(x) = mx + b.
A table of successive outputs reads 20, 25, 30, 35. Is the relationship linear or exponential, and why?
choices: Quadratic; the second differences are constant.
Exponential; successive outputs have a constant ratio of 5.
Neither; the pattern does not repeat.
Linear; successive outputs differ by a constant 5.
